observations.body: A woman pours costly ointment on Jesus while disciples object to the apparent waste.
observations.label: Gift and objection

observations.body: Burial, the poor, worldwide proclamation, and memory of her act answer the objection.
observations.label: Jesus’s reply

observations.body: One of the Twelve asks the priests for payment and begins seeking an opportunity.
observations.label: Judas’s movement

payload.posture: Stay with this witness’s people, objects, speech, sequence, and stated connections before moving to another account or later use.
payload.tension: A remembered act of costly giving and a priced agreement to deliver Jesus stand next to one another before preparation begins.
payload.title: Anointing for burial and Judas’s agreement fill the interval
